generation__canvas__custom.description: Applies your own instruction to the Canvas document or selection and returns only the new text.

generation__canvas__expand.title: Canvas: expand
generation__canvas__expand.description: Adds detail and examples to the Canvas content and replaces it.

generation__canvas__explain.title: Canvas: explain
generation__canvas__explain.description: Explains what the Canvas content does, step by step, shown beside the document.

generation__canvas__fix.title: Canvas: fix
generation__canvas__fix.description: Fixes bugs, syntax errors, and typos in the Canvas content and replaces it.

generation__canvas__format.title: Canvas: format
generation__canvas__format.description: Tidies the indentation, spacing, and structure of the Canvas content and replaces it.

generation__canvas__improve.title: Canvas: improve
generation__canvas__improve.description: Improves the readability and structure of the Canvas content and replaces it.

generation__canvas__review.title: Canvas: review
generation__canvas__review.description: Reviews the Canvas content for issues and improvements, shown beside the document.

generation__canvas__run.title: Canvas: simulate run
generation__canvas__run.description: Describes what the Canvas code would output if run, without actually running it.

generation__canvas__simplify.title: Canvas: simplify
generation__canvas__simplify.description: Simplifies the Canvas content while keeping its meaning, and replaces it.

generation__canvas__translate.title: Canvas: translate
generation__canvas__translate.description: Translates the Canvas content into the chosen language, keeping its formatting.

generation__council__synthesis.title: Council synthesis
generation__council__synthesis.description: Merges the council members' answers into one response and rates how far they agreed.

generation__image-edit__remove-backgroun.title: Remove image background
generation__image-edit__remove-backgroun.description: Asks the image model to remove the background, in the chat image workbench and the plugin media tools.

generation__pet__hatch-sprite.title: Pet sprite hatch draft
generation__pet__hatch-sprite.description: Drafts a new chat asking an agent to create an animated pet sprite that you can then import.

generation__summary__conversation.title: Conversation summary
generation__summary__conversation.description: Summarizes a conversation to seed a new branch or to stand in for older turns after compaction.

generation__summary__selection.title: Selection summary
generation__summary__selection.description: Summarizes material you selected in a chat, to show you or to seed a handoff.

generation__template-assist__generate.title: Template draft
generation__template-assist__generate.description: Writes a new message template with fill-in parameters from your description, in the template editor.

generation__template-assist__improve.title: Template rewrite
generation__template-assist__improve.description: Rewrites a message template more clearly while keeping every parameter slot in place.

generation__template-assist__suggest-par.title: Template parameter hints
generation__template-assist__suggest-par.description: Suggests a label and a short hint for each parameter slot in a message template.

generation__title__chat.title: Chat title
generation__title__chat.description: Names a conversation from its first exchange.

generation__title__work.title: Task or run title
generation__title__work.description: Names an automated task or workflow run in a few words.

generation__turn-label.title: Turn label
generation__turn-label.description: Labels a single chat turn in five words or fewer for the conversation timeline.

goal__continuation.title: Goal continuation turn
goal__continuation.description: Protocol text read by the host: the message asking the agent to take the next step toward the goal.

goal__judge.title: Goal completion judge
goal__judge.description: Decides from the agent's latest reply whether the goal is fully done, answering in JSON.

goal__objective-updated.title: Goal objective update
goal__objective-updated.description: Protocol text read by the host: tells the agent you revised the goal and the old objective no longer applies.

goal__promise-verification.title: Goal completion check
goal__promise-verification.description: Protocol text read by the host: asks the agent to confirm completion with an exact token before the goal closes.

goal__subgoals.title: Goal checklist
goal__subgoals.description: Breaks a goal into 3 to 8 ordered sub-steps shown as its checklist.

goal__system-section.title: Active goal section
goal__system-section.description: Shows the active goal and its progress in the system prompt on every turn while a /goal runs.

knowledge__memory__consolidate.title: Memory consolidation
knowledge__memory__consolidate.description: Decides whether a new memory adds to, updates, removes, or conflicts with similar stored memories.

knowledge__memory__episodic-distill.title: Episodic memory distill
knowledge__memory__episodic-distill.description: After a chat goes idle, picks out decisions and events worth recalling in later sessions.

knowledge__memory__episodic-distill__req.title: Episodic memory request
knowledge__memory__episodic-distill__req.description: The request carrying the conversation, and the JSON shape episodic memory distilling must return.

knowledge__memory__extract.title: User memory extraction
knowledge__memory__extract.description: Picks out lasting facts about you, such as preferences and environment, from each conversation turn.

knowledge__memory__project-extract.title: Project memory extraction
knowledge__memory__project-extract.description: Extracts lasting facts about a software project from its own development conversations.

knowledge__memory__rerank.title: Memory recall reranker
knowledge__memory__rerank.description: Scores how relevant each stored memory is to the current query during recall.

knowledge__ocr__vision.title: CLI image OCR
knowledge__ocr__vision.description: Extracts all the text from an attached page image as Markdown in the CLI.

knowledge__radar.title: Knowledge radar
knowledge__radar.description: Diagnoses your information diet from recently saved items, including blind spots and next actions.

knowledge__rag__hyde.title: Retrieval: hypothetical answer
knowledge__rag__hyde.description: Writes a short imagined answer passage that is used as an extra search query during retrieval.

knowledge__rag__step-back.title: Retrieval: step-back question
knowledge__rag__step-back.description: Writes a broader background question that is used as an extra search query during retrieval.

knowledge__web-search__answer.title: Web search answer
knowledge__web-search__answer.description: Answers your question from numbered web sources with citations, shown above the sources.

knowledge__web__fetch-extract.title: Web page extraction
knowledge__web__fetch-extract.description: Pulls only the parts of a fetched web page that answer the question, keeping facts verbatim.

knowledge__web__reader-distill.title: Web reader summary
knowledge__web__reader-distill.description: The default question the web reader uses to summarize a page's key facts when distilling it.

knowledge__wiki__voice.title: Code wiki writing voice
knowledge__wiki__voice.description: Sets how the code wiki writes articles and index pages: concise, grounded, and aimed at coding agents.

permissions__command-judge.title: Shell command safety judge
permissions__command-judge.description: Decides whether a shell command is safe to run without asking you first.

routing__difficulty-judge.title: Request difficulty judge
routing__difficulty-judge.description: Rates how capable a model a request needs, to pick a fast, balanced, or powerful model.

routing__fusion__role__common.title: Fusion: shared role rules
routing__fusion__role__common.description: Rules every Router + Fusion role follows: treat inputs as data, cite real evidence, never fake results.

routing__fusion__role__compactor.title: Fusion: context compactor
routing__fusion__role__compactor.description: Condenses a long transcript into a handoff that keeps goals, constraints, and open issues.

routing__fusion__role__judge.title: Fusion: judge
routing__fusion__role__judge.description: Has the judge check candidate answers against the task and evidence rather than vote or merge them.

routing__fusion__role__lead.title: Fusion: lead planner
routing__fusion__role__lead.description: Has the lead plan subtasks for workers and then review their results.

routing__fusion__role__panel-member.title: Fusion: panel member
routing__fusion__role__panel-member.description: Has a panel member answer the whole task on its own, with its claims backed by evidence.

routing__fusion__role__reviewer.title: Fusion: content reviewer
routing__fusion__role__reviewer.description: Has a reviewer check a result against the rubric, marking each check passed, failed, or unclear.

routing__fusion__role__synthesizer.title: Fusion: synthesizer
routing__fusion__role__synthesizer.description: Writes the final answer from supported claims and keeps unresolved points marked as uncertain.

routing__fusion__role__worker.title: Fusion: worker
routing__fusion__role__worker.description: Has a worker carry out one approved subtask in an isolated workspace and report honestly.

team__auto__assess-routing.title: Team: routing assessment
team__auto__assess-routing.description: Recommends how to orchestrate an objective, from a single agent up to a full team.

team__auto__clarify.title: Team: clarifying questions
team__auto__clarify.description: Decides whether an Agent Team objective needs a few clarifying questions before planning.

team__auto__compose-roster.title: Team: roster composition
team__auto__compose-roster.description: Proposes a small team of specialists for an objective, with the lead first.

team__auto__decompose-tasks.title: Team: task breakdown
team__auto__decompose-tasks.description: Breaks an objective into up to 16 ordered tasks with assignees and dependencies.

team__lead-review.title: Team: lead review
team__lead-review.description: Has the team lead approve a teammate's finished work or request changes.

team__lead__planning.title: Team: lead plan request
team__lead__planning.description: Asks the team lead for a plan of 3 to 6 steps assigned to teammates.

team__lead__planning-system.title: Team: lead planning system prompt
team__lead__planning-system.description: The default system prompt for a team lead's planning, requiring a single JSON plan block.

team__ledger__judge.title: Team: stall judge
team__ledger__judge.description: Works out why an Agent Team has stalled and recommends one next action.

team__ledger__schema-hint.title: Team: stall verdict schema
team__ledger__schema-hint.description: Protocol text read by the parser: the JSON shape the stall judge must return.

team__pattern__adversarial-verify__lens-.title: Skeptic lens: correctness
team__pattern__adversarial-verify__lens-.description: Asks a skeptic to check whether the finding is a real logic or behavior defect.

team__pattern__adversarial-verify__lens-.title: Skeptic lens: performance
team__pattern__adversarial-verify__lens-.description: Asks a skeptic to judge whether the performance impact is real at realistic scale.

team__pattern__adversarial-verify__lens-.title: Skeptic lens: reproduction
team__pattern__adversarial-verify__lens-.description: Asks a skeptic to actually reproduce the finding before accepting it.

team__pattern__adversarial-verify__lens-.title: Skeptic lens: security
team__pattern__adversarial-verify__lens-.description: Asks a skeptic to judge whether the finding is a security issue an attacker can exploit.

team__pattern__adversarial-verify__skept.title: Pattern: skeptic prompt
team__pattern__adversarial-verify__skept.description: Has a skeptic try to refute one finding during adversarial verification.

team__pattern__adversarial-verify__verdi.title: Pattern: skeptic verdict schema
team__pattern__adversarial-verify__verdi.description: Protocol text read by the parser: the JSON shape one skeptic verdict must return.

team__pattern__completeness-critic__crit.title: Pattern: completeness critic prompt
team__pattern__completeness-critic__crit.description: Names what the work so far has missed, feeding the next search round and the final report.

team__pattern__completeness-critic__gaps.title: Pattern: gaps schema
team__pattern__completeness-critic__gaps.description: Protocol text read by the parser: the JSON shape the completeness critic must return.

team__pattern__judge-panel__attempt.title: Pattern: judge panel attempt
team__pattern__judge-panel__attempt.description: Has an agent attempt the objective from one assigned angle for the judge panel.

team__pattern__judge-panel__attempt-sche.title: Pattern: attempt schema
team__pattern__judge-panel__attempt-sche.description: Protocol text read by the parser: the JSON shape one judge panel attempt must return.

team__pattern__judge-panel__judge.title: Pattern: judge panel scoring
team__pattern__judge-panel__judge.description: Has a judge score one attempt from 0 to 10 against the objective.

team__pattern__judge-panel__score-schema.title: Pattern: judge score schema
team__pattern__judge-panel__score-schema.description: Protocol text read by the parser: the JSON shape one judge score must return.

team__pattern__loop-until-dry__finder.title: Pattern: loop finder prompt
team__pattern__loop-until-dry__finder.description: Asks a finder for new findings only, round after round, until rounds come back empty.

team__pattern__multi-modal-sweep__finder.title: Pattern: sweep finder prompt
team__pattern__multi-modal-sweep__finder.description: Has each finder in a multi-modal sweep search with only its assigned approach.

team__pattern__shared__findings-schema.title: Pattern: findings schema
team__pattern__shared__findings-schema.description: Protocol text read by the parser: the JSON shape finders in the sweep and loop patterns must return.

team__pattern__synthesize__report.title: Pattern: final report prompt
team__pattern__synthesize__report.description: Writes the run's final report from verified findings, noting open gaps as limits.

team__pattern__synthesize__report-schema.title: Pattern: final report schema
team__pattern__synthesize__report-schema.description: Protocol text read by the parser: the JSON shape the final report must return.

team__pr-feedback__reviewer.title: Team: PR reviewer
team__pr-feedback__reviewer.description: The internal reviewer's role for an Agent Team: review only the pull request's changes.

team__pr-feedback__reviewer-task.title: Team: PR review request
team__pr-feedback__reviewer-task.description: Names the pull request to review and asks the internal reviewer for a JSON verdict.

team__rate-limit__nudge.title: Team: rate limit resume
team__rate-limit__nudge.description: Posted to the team after a rate-limit cooldown, telling members to pick up where they stopped.

team__replan__lead.title: Team: replan checkpoint
team__replan__lead.description: Has the lead decide after each wave whether to continue, add, cancel, or change tasks.

team__review__revision-request.title: Team: revision request
team__review__revision-request.description: The request sent back to a teammate with the lead's feedback, asking for a revision.

team__structured__json-instruction.title: Team: JSON reply rule
team__structured__json-instruction.description: Protocol text read by the parser: tells a teammate to reply with one JSON block matching the schema.

team__structured__retry-note.title: Team: JSON retry note
team__structured__retry-note.description: Protocol text read by the parser: asks a teammate for corrected JSON after an invalid reply.

team__teammate__default-identity.title: Team: default teammate identity
team__teammate__default-identity.description: The teammate system prompt used when nothing else sets one.

team__teammate__task.title: Team: teammate task
team__teammate__task.description: Hands a teammate its assigned task, its role, and the team goal.

team__teammate__upstream-results.title: Team: upstream results
team__teammate__upstream-results.description: Introduces the results of tasks a teammate depends on, placed before its own task.

team__ultracode__plan-hint.title: Ultracode plan schema
team__ultracode__plan-hint.description: Protocol text read by the parser: the JSON shape the ultracode planner must return.

team__ultracode__planner.title: Ultracode planner
team__ultracode__planner.description: Chooses which quality patterns an ultracode run combines, and in what order.

twin__distill__entity-merge.title: Twin distill: entity merging
twin__distill__entity-merge.description: Groups different names for the same team, person, or project found while building the twin.

twin__distill__evaluator.title: Twin distill: reviewer
twin__distill__evaluator.description: Scores the twin's Agent and Skill drafts from a newcomer's point of view and suggests fixes.

twin__distill__knowledge.title: Twin distill: entities and decisions
twin__distill__knowledge.description: Extracts the people, teams, projects, and decisions in your material for the digital twin.

twin__distill__playbook.title: Twin distill: playbooks
twin__distill__playbook.description: Finds work patterns you repeat across documents and chats, to become the twin's playbooks.

twin__distill__style.title: Twin distill: writing style
twin__distill__style.description: Picks representative samples of your writing so the digital twin can match your tone.

twin__distill__synthesizer.title: Twin distill: synthesizer
twin__distill__synthesizer.description: Turns the distilled profile into one Agent draft and several Skill drafts for the digital twin.

twin__runtime__rerank.title: Twin search reranker
twin__runtime__rerank.description: Scores how well each retrieved document answers a question when the twin searches its material.

twin__runtime__rerank-request.title: Twin rerank request
twin__runtime__rerank-request.description: Protocol text read by the parser: the request carrying the query and documents to the twin reranker.

twin__runtime__system-template__decision.title: Twin prompt: decisions
twin__runtime__system-template__decision.description: Adds the decisions the person has made to the digital twin's system prompt.

twin__runtime__system-template__entities.title: Twin prompt: known people
twin__runtime__system-template__entities.description: Adds the people, teams, and projects the twin knows, as background it should not list unprompted.

twin__runtime__system-template__identity.title: Twin prompt: identity
twin__runtime__system-template__identity.description: Opens the digital twin's system prompt by telling it whose name it speaks under.

twin__runtime__system-template__playbook.title: Twin prompt: playbooks
twin__runtime__system-template__playbook.description: Adds how the person typically handles situations to the digital twin's system prompt.

twin__runtime__system-template__retrieve.title: Twin prompt: retrieved material
twin__runtime__system-template__retrieve.description: Adds the excerpts retrieved for this turn and asks the twin to cite them or admit gaps.

twin__runtime__system-template__style.title: Twin prompt: style examples
twin__runtime__system-template__style.description: Adds samples of the person's writing for the twin to match without copying them.

twin__runtime__system-template__voice.title: Twin prompt: voice
twin__runtime__system-template__voice.description: Adds the person's voice and tone summary to the digital twin's system prompt.
